text:
Priya: :warning: Multiple customer reports: hosted inference returning 502/504s and a spike in auth failures (us-east-1). Opening war room here — please ack and paste any traces.
Alex: Acked. Oncall checking ingress and gateway metrics now. Any recent deploys in the last hour?
Mateo: I see a deployment to auth-proxy 2 minutes ago (canary). Rolling logs now.
INCIDENT_BOT: Alert: observed 502-rate increase (p95 gateway latency 1.9s -> 5.8s) between 12:32:40 - 12:34:50 UTC. Incident channel created.
Jess: Customer support: multiple tickets reporting timeouts while generating. Some show 401s followed by 504s. Raising priority to P1 for affected customers.
Alex: Quick check: gateway logs show upstream ECONNRESET to runtime pool + 504 from model-runtime. Sharing tail:
```
2026-03-10T12:33:12Z gateway INFO request_id=rid-8a2 upstream=10.2.3.45:504 error="upstream timeout"
2026-03-10T12:33:13Z auth-proxy WARN token-fetch trace=tx-332 err="kms throttle"
2026-03-10T12:33:14Z runtime ERROR model=redwood-medium trace=tx-332 err="kv-cache-timeout"
```
Mateo: KMS logs show brief elevated latencies and 429s around 12:33. Looks like token refresh for a fraction of requests failed and caused retries that cascaded into runtime backlog.
Nikhil: We shipped a change to auth-proxy token refresh backoff last deploy. If token fetch slows, auth-proxy blocks requests waiting for tokens — could explain 401/504 combo.
Priya: Mitigation plan: 1) revert canary auth-proxy config 2) enable short-term fallback token cache (force cached tokens for 60s) 3) open autoscale on runtime pool + increase ingress concurrency limits. Who can do the revert now?
Alex: Rolling back auth-proxy canary to previous stable (2.14.1) now. ETA ~3 min. Switching concurrency gating to allow more in-flight requests.
Mateo: Scaling runtime pool +2 nodes in us-east-1. Watching queue lengths.
Jess: Support: informing affected customers that we have a mitigation in progress and will follow up with RCA. Posting a templated update now.
INCIDENT_BOT: Deploy rollback completed at 12:36:05 UTC. Telemetry shows p95 latency falling back toward baseline.
Alex: After rollback, gateway 504s dropped ~80% in 2 mins. Auth failure rate also reduced. Looks like rollback mitigated the primary cause.
Priya: Good. Next steps (short-term):
- Verify no residual KMS throttles — Mateo to confirm.
- Add temporary rate limit backpressure at edge to avoid cascading spikes — Nikhil to apply.
- Triage tickets and send individual customer notes — Jess to lead.
Nikhil: Applying conservative edge backpressure now (rate-limit per API key -> 20 rps). Will monitor for errors.
Mateo: KMS latencies normalized after traffic dampening. No ongoing 429s now.
Jess: Customer comms sent. Customers acknowledge and appreciate proactive updates. Logging their case IDs for postmortem.
Priya: Assigning postmortem: Jess (owner), Alex (runtime investigator), Mateo (infra/KMS), Nikhil (auth-proxy). Draft doc: https://redwood.example.com/pm/4955550000-postmortem (please add notes).
Alex: Initial hypothesis: token-refresh backoff + KMS transient throttling caused auth-proxy to block, producing 401s and inflight queues backing up into runtime timeouts (504/502).
Nikhil: Action items I will own:
- Revert change on token backoff algorithm (done) — verify with canary before re-deploy.
- Add circuit for token-fetch path so requests don't block on token retrieval (proposal in PR #842)
Mateo: Action items I will own:
- Request increased KMS burst quota and add alert for >1% 429s in 5m.
- Tune runtime autoscaler to react faster to auth-induced bursts.
Jess: Action items I will own:
- Compile customer impact list and timeline for communications.
- Run full ticket sweep and escalate billing-impacting cases.
Priya: Short checklist before war room close:
- [x] rollback completed
- [x] edge rate-limit applied
- [x] runtime nodes scaled
- [ ] postmortem doc created (Jess)
- [ ] follow-up meeting scheduled
Jess: I'll create the postmortem doc and schedule a follow-up at 2026-03-11 15:00 UTC. Invite: eng-runtime, eng-infra, support.
Alex: Quick log snippet for RCA section (please paste into doc):
```
# trace tx-332
gateway -> auth-proxy -> KMS(429) -> auth-proxy retry -> runtime queue + timeout
```
Priya: Thanks all. Closing active war room in 15m unless regressions. We'll move to postmortem channel with final timeline and owner assignments. :white_check_mark:
Nikhil: One more: let's add a synthetic that validates token-fetch latency every 30s (low-cost check). I'll add a ticket.
Jess: Postmortem doc: https://redwood.example.com/pm/4955550000-postmortem (created). Adding timeline + customer notes now.
Priya: Final note: immediate customer billing-impact checks should be triaged — if any customer saw partial failures with billing events, escalate to finance and support. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
